about: Milestone 0 as it stood when fizz-hello was deleted. The crate, its golden transcript, its M0_SCRIPT and the 600-tick BIOS tick bound of tools/check-dos.sh no longer exist in the tree, so the chapters that describe Milestone 0 read these frozen values. Written once from the tree before the deletion; do not regenerate. The measured run of Milestone 0's three gates (tools/check-dos.sh, tools/build-web.sh, tools/check-parity.sh) is kept under `measured`.

measured.parityWhen: 27 October 2026, on the tree of main at e657aa2
measured.how: On the tree of main at e657aa2, with vendor/ linked to a local copy of the ci-dos toolchain layout (DJGPP, DOSBox Staging 0.83.0, CWSDPMI): `DOS_TOOLCHAIN=... tools/setup-dos.sh`, then `tools/check-dos.sh` (which printed the replay, the platform lines, MOVED yes, PANIC exit 3, SIZE 32768, BUDGET 1100000 and DOS CHECK ok), `tools/build-web.sh`, and `tools/check-parity.sh` (which printed native, web and dos matches and PARITY ok efc699079baa6a88). Rust 1.98.0, wasm-bindgen 0.2.125, Node 22.21.1. The lines below are copied from that output unedited, carriage returns removed.  Every figure was unchanged from the run at 3d5a2d2.
